up: Identify all distinct targets (ChEMBL ID and preferred name) for assays where the assay organism is Staphylococcus aureus. Return a list of unique target entries.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name FROM assays a JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid WHERE a.assay_organism = 'Staphylococcus aureus'
